title: lithocarpus talangensis
intro: Lithocarpus talangensis, commonly known as Talang Walnut, is a plant species in the beech family (Fagaceae) that is native to Indonesia. The health benefits of Lithocarpus talangensis include its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of antioxidants and other nutrients. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus talangensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
